jsonld_raw.name: COCOA SUNSET SHIMMERING BODY OIL 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
COCOA SUNSET SHIMMERING BODY OIL 100 ML (3.4 FL. OZ). The iconic Cocoa Sunset fragrance in a shimmering body oil format combines a luminous glow with its unmistakable scent to enhance the olfactory experience. Milk chocolate and whipped cream melt with a golden touch of vanilla, while notes of passion fruit and peach add a bright, fruity facet. The result is a warm and enveloping fragrance that leaves the skin radiant.

Amber gourmand | Sweet, creamy, and comforting.
